item_name: Rothco Deep Concealment Concealed Carry Chest Holster
item_short_desc: Securely carry your firearm with Rothco's Deep Concealment Concealed Carry Chest Holster.
description: Securely carry your firearm with Rothco's Deep Concealment Concealed Carry Chest Holster. The concealed carry holster has been designed to evenly distribute the weight of the gun to your back and shoulders allowing for an easy all day carry. The gun holster, as well as the two mag pouches, are secured with a snap closure. Available in two sizes the deep concealment holster is fully adjustable.
